translations.idiomatic: Huiqing said: "The Shaanxi armies cannot only not attack—they also cannot defend. What matters is simply to create a great posture."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「如惠卿言，是為陝西可棄也，豈宜委以邊事？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "As Huiqing says, this means Shaanxi can be abandoned—how can he be entrusted with frontier affairs?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "As Huiqing says, this means Shaanxi can be abandoned—how can he be entrusted with frontier affairs?"

sentences.zh: 數其輕躁矯誣之罪，斥知單州，明年復知太原。

translations.literal: He counted his crimes of rashness and false accusation, dismissed him as prefect of Shan Prefecture, and the next year again made him prefect of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He counted his crimes of rashness and false accusation, dismissed him as prefect of Shan Prefecture, and the next year again made him prefect of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 哲宗即位，敕疆吏勿侵擾外界。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, he ordered frontier officials not to harass outside realms.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong ascended the throne, he ordered frontier officials not to harass outside realms.

sentences.zh: 惠卿遣步騎二萬襲夏人於聚星泊，斬首六百級，夏人遂寇鄜延。

translations.literal: Huiqing sent twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to raid the Xia people at Juxing Marsh, taking six hundred heads; the Xia people then raided Fuyan.
translations.idiomatic: Huiqing sent twenty thousand infantry and cavalry to raid the Xia people at Juxing Marsh, taking six hundred heads. The Xia people then raided Fuyan.

sentences.zh: 惠卿見正人匯進，知不容于時，懇求散地。

translations.literal: Huiqing saw upright men gathering in office and knew he could not remain in the times; he earnestly requested a nominal post.
translations.idiomatic: Huiqing saw upright men gathering in office and knew he could not remain at court. He earnestly requested a nominal post.

sentences.zh: 於是右司諫蘇轍條奏其奸曰：「惠卿懷張湯之辨詐，有盧杞之奸邪，詭變多端，敢行非度。

translations.literal: Thereupon Right Secretariat Remonstrance Official Su Che memorialized item by item on his treachery, saying: "Huiqing harbors Zhang Tang's sophistry and deceit and Lu Qi's treachery and wickedness; he changes deviously in many ways and dares to act beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Right Secretariat Remonstrance Official Su Che memorialized item by item on his treachery, saying: "Huiqing harbors Zhang Tang's sophistry and deceit and Lu Qi's treachery and wickedness. He changes deviously in many ways and dares to act beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 王安石強亻艮傲誕，於吏事宜無所知，惠卿指扌適教導，以濟其惡。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi was strong, stubborn, and arrogant, knowing nothing of administrative affairs; Huiqing pointed and directed, teaching and guiding, to advance his wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi was strong, stubborn, and arrogant, knowing nothing of administrative affairs. Huiqing pointed and directed, teaching and guiding, to advance his wickedness.

sentences.zh: 又興起大獄，欲株連蔓引，塗汙公卿。

translations.literal: He also launched great prosecutions, wishing to implicate by extension and branch, and defile dukes and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: He also launched great prosecutions, wishing to implicate by extension and branch, and defile dukes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 賴先帝仁聖，每事裁抑，不然，安常守道之士無噍類矣。

translations.literal: Thanks to the late emperor's benevolence and sagacity, who restrained each matter, otherwise men who upheld constancy and kept to the Way would have been wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: Thanks to the late emperor's benevolence and sagacity, who restrained each matter—otherwise men who upheld constancy and kept to the Way would have been wiped out.

sentences.zh: 安石于惠卿有卵翼之恩，父師之義。

translations.literal: Anshi toward Huiqing had the grace of sheltering wings and the duty of father and teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi toward Huiqing had the grace of sheltering wings and the duty of father and teacher.

sentences.zh: 方其求進則膠固為一，及勢力相軋，化為敵仇，發其私書，不遺餘力。

translations.literal: When he sought advancement they were glued together as one; when power clashed they became enemy foes, and he exposed Anshi's private letters with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: When he sought advancement they were glued together as one. When power clashed they became enemy foes, and he exposed Anshi's private letters with all his strength.

sentences.zh: 犬彘之所不為，而惠卿為之。

translations.literal: What dogs and pigs would not do, Huiqing did.
translations.idiomatic: What dogs and pigs would not do, Huiqing did.

sentences.zh: 昔呂布事丁原則殺丁原，事董卓則殺董卓；

translations.literal: In the past Lü Bu served Ding Yuan and killed Ding Yuan, served Dong Zhuo and killed Dong Zhuo;
translations.idiomatic: In the past Lü Bu served Ding Yuan and killed Ding Yuan, served Dong Zhuo and killed Dong Zhuo;

sentences.zh: 劉牢之事王恭則反王恭，事司馬元顯則反元顯，故曹操、桓玄終畏而誅之。

translations.literal: Liu Laozhi served Wang Gong and rebelled against Wang Gong, served Sima Yuanxian and rebelled against Yuanxian—therefore Cao Cao and Huan Xuan in the end feared and executed them.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Laozhi served Wang Gong and rebelled against Wang Gong, served Sima Yuanxian and rebelled against Yuanxian. Therefore Cao Cao and Huan Xuan in the end feared and executed them.

sentences.zh: 如惠卿之惡，縱未正典刑，猶當投畀四裔，以禦魑魅。」

translations.literal: For wickedness like Huiqing's, even if not punished by proper law, he should still be cast to the four frontiers to ward off demons.
translations.idiomatic: For wickedness like Huiqing's, even if not punished by proper law, he should still be cast to the four frontiers to ward off demons.

sentences.zh: 中丞劉摯數其五罪，以為大惡。

translations.literal: Vice censor Liu Zhi counted his five crimes and considered them great wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: Vice censor Liu Zhi counted his five crimes and considered them great wickedness.

sentences.zh: 乃貶為光祿卿、分司南京。

translations.literal: He was then demoted to Grandee of Splendid Happiness with nominal duty in the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was then demoted to Grandee of Splendid Happiness with nominal duty in the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 再責建寧軍節度副使、建州安置。

translations.literal: Again punished as military commissioner deputy of Jianning Army and assigned to Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Again punished as military commissioner deputy of Jianning Army and assigned to Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人蘇軾當制，備載其罪於訓詞，天下傳訟稱快焉。

translations.literal: Secretariat drafter Su Shi drafted the edict, fully recording his crimes in the instruction; the realm spread the word and rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat drafter Su Shi drafted the edict, fully recording his crimes in the instruction. The realm spread the word and rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 紹聖中，復資政殿學士、知大名府，加觀文殿學士、知延州。

translations.literal: During Shaosheng he was again made academician of the Zizheng Hall and prefect of Daming, then added Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall and prefect of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Shaosheng he was again made academician of the Zizheng Hall and prefect of Daming, then added Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall and prefect of Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏人復入寇，將以全師圍延安，惠卿修米脂諸砦以備。

translations.literal: The Xia people again invaded and were about to surround Yan'an with their full army; Huiqing repaired the forts at Mizhi and elsewhere to prepare.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia people again invaded and were about to surround Yan'an with their full army. Huiqing repaired the forts at Mizhi and elsewhere to prepare.

sentences.zh: 寇至，欲攻則城不可近，欲掠則野無所得，欲戰則諸將按兵不動，欲南則懼腹背受敵，留二日即拔柵去，遂陷金明。

translations.literal: When the raiders arrived, they wished to attack but could not approach the city; wished to plunder but found nothing in the wilds; wished to fight but the generals held their troops still; wished to go south but feared attack front and rear. After two days they pulled up their palisades and left, and then Jinming fell.
translations.idiomatic: When the raiders arrived, they wished to attack but could not approach the city; wished to plunder but found nothing in the wilds; wished to fight but the generals held their troops still; wished to go south but feared attack front and rear. After two days they pulled up their palisades and left, and then Jinming fell.

sentences.zh: 惠卿求詣闕，不許。

translations.literal: Huiqing requested to go to court; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Huiqing requested to go to court; it was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 以築威戎、威羌城，加銀青光祿大夫，拜保甯、武勝兩軍節度使。

translations.literal: For building Weirong and Weiqiang cities, he was given Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and appointed military commissioner of Baoning and Wusheng armies.
translations.idiomatic: For building Weirong and Weiqiang cities, he was given Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and appointed military commissioner of Baoning and Wusheng armies.

sentences.zh: 徽宗立，易節鎮南。

translations.literal: When Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, his command was changed to Zhennan.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, his command was changed to Zhennan.

sentences.zh: 因曾布有宿憾，徙為杭州，而用范純粹帥延，治其上功罔冒事，奪節度。

translations.literal: Because of old resentment with Zeng Bu, he was transferred to Hang Prefecture; Fan Chuncui was used to command Yan and investigated his false claims of merit, stripping his military commission.
translations.idiomatic: Because of old resentment with Zeng Bu, he was transferred to Hang Prefecture. Fan Chuncui was used to command Yan and investigated his false claims of merit, stripping his military commission.

sentences.zh: 布去位，復武昌節度使、知大名。

translations.literal: When Bu left office, Huiqing was again military commissioner of Wuchang and prefect of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: When Bu left office, Huiqing was again military commissioner of Wuchang and prefect of Daming.

sentences.zh: 數歲，又以上表引喻失當，還為銀青光祿大夫，令致仕。

translations.literal: After several years, again because a memorial used improper analogies, he was reduced to Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: After several years, again because a memorial used improper analogies, he was reduced to Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and ordered to retire.

sentences.zh: 崇寧五年，起為觀文殿學士、知杭州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongning he was recalled as Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall and prefect of Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongning he was recalled as Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall and prefect of Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 坐其子淵聞妖人張懷素言不告，淵配沙門島，惠卿責祁州團練副使，安置宣州，再移廬州。

translations.literal: Because his son Yuan heard the words of the sorcerer Zhang Huaisu and did not report them, Yuan was assigned to Shamen Island; Huiqing was punished as military training deputy of Qi Prefecture, assigned to Xuan Prefecture, and again transferred to Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because his son Yuan heard the words of the sorcerer Zhang Huaisu and did not report them, Yuan was assigned to Shamen Island. Huiqing was punished as military training deputy of Qi Prefecture, assigned to Xuan Prefecture, and again transferred to Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復觀文殿學士，為醴泉觀使，致仕。

translations.literal: He was again Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall, made commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: He was again Hanlin academician of the Guanwen Hall, made commissioner of the Liquan Abbey, and retired.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given Grand Preceptor with equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously given Grand Preceptor with equal ceremony to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 始，惠卿逢合安石，驟致執政，安石去位，遂極力排之，至發其私書於上。

translations.literal: At first Huiqing ingratiated himself with Anshi and suddenly reached the chief councilor's seat; when Anshi left office, he then strove with all his might to oppose him, even exposing his private letters to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At first Huiqing ingratiated himself with Anshi and suddenly reached the chief councilor's seat. When Anshi left office, he then strove with all his might to oppose him, even exposing his private letters to the throne.

sentences.zh: 安石退處金陵，往往寫「福建子」三字，蓋深悔為惠卿所誤也。

translations.literal: Anshi retired to Jinling and often wrote the three characters "Fujian fellow"—he deeply regretted being misled by Huiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Anshi retired to Jinling and often wrote the three characters "Fujian fellow"—he deeply regretted being misled by Huiqing.

sentences.zh: 雖章惇、曾布、蔡京當國，鹹畏惡其人，不敢引入朝。

translations.literal: Although Zhang Dun, Zeng Bu, and Cai Jing held the state, all feared and hated the man and dared not bring him into court.
translations.idiomatic: Although Zhang Dun, Zeng Bu, and Cai Jing held the state, all feared and hated the man and dared not bring him into court.

sentences.zh: 以是轉徙外服，訖於死雲。

translations.literal: For this reason he was transferred among outer posts until his death.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason he was transferred among outer posts until his death.

sentences.zh: 章惇字子厚，建州浦城人，父俞徙蘇州。

translations.literal: Zhang Dun, courtesy name Zihou, was a native of Pucheng in Jian Prefecture; his father Yu moved to Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dun, courtesy name Zihou, was a native of Pucheng in Jian Prefecture. His father Yu moved to Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 起家至職方郎中，致仕，用惇貴，累官銀青光祿大夫，年八十九卒。

translations.literal: He rose from office to director in the Ministry of Personnel and retired; through Dun's eminence he accumulated posts to Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and died at eighty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from office to director in the Ministry of Personnel and retired. Through Dun's eminence he accumulated posts to Silver Blue-Green Grandee of Splendid Happiness and died at eighty-nine.

sentences.zh: 惇豪俊，博學善文。

translations.literal: Dun was bold and handsome, broadly learned and skilled at writing.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was bold and handsome, broadly learned and skilled at writing.

sentences.zh: 進士登名，恥出侄衡下，委敕而出。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination but was ashamed to rank below his nephew Heng; he abandoned his appointment and left.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination but was ashamed to rank below his nephew Heng. He abandoned his appointment and left.

sentences.zh: 再舉甲科，調商洛令。

translations.literal: He passed again in the top class and was assigned magistrate of Shangluo.
translations.idiomatic: He passed again in the top class and was assigned magistrate of Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 與蘇軾游南山，抵仙遊潭，潭下臨絕壁萬仞，橫木其上，惇揖軾書壁，軾懼不敢書。

translations.literal: With Su Shi he toured South Mountain and reached Xianyou Pool; below the pool was a cliff of ten thousand ren, with a horizontal log across it. Dun bowed and asked Shi to write on the wall; Shi was afraid and did not dare write.
translations.idiomatic: With Su Shi he toured South Mountain and reached Xianyou Pool. Below the pool was a cliff of ten thousand ren, with a horizontal log across it. Dun bowed and asked Shi to write on the wall; Shi was afraid and did not dare write.

sentences.zh: 惇平步過之，垂索挽樹，攝衣而下，以漆墨濡筆大書石壁曰：「蘇軾、章惇來。」

translations.literal: Dun walked calmly across, let down a rope and grabbed a tree, gathered his robes and descended, dipped his brush in lacquer ink, and wrote large on the stone wall: "Su Shi and Zhang Dun came."
translations.idiomatic: Dun walked calmly across, let down a rope and grabbed a tree, gathered his robes and descended, dipped his brush in lacquer ink, and wrote large on the stone wall: "Su Shi and Zhang Dun came."

sentences.zh: 既還，神彩不動，軾拊其背曰：「君他日必能殺人。」

translations.literal: When he returned, his expression was unchanged. Shi patted his back and said: "You will surely be able to kill men one day."
translations.idiomatic: When he returned, his expression was unchanged. Shi patted his back and said: "You will surely be able to kill men one day."

sentences.zh: 惇曰：「何也？」

translations.literal: Dun said: "Why?"
translations.idiomatic: Dun said: "Why?"

sentences.zh: 軾曰：「能自判命者，能殺人也。」

translations.literal: Shi said: "One who can risk his own life can kill others."
translations.idiomatic: Shi said: "One who can risk his own life can kill others."

sentences.zh: 惇大笑。

translations.literal: Dun laughed loudly.
translations.idiomatic: Dun laughed loudly.

sentences.zh: 召試館職，王陶劾罷之。

translations.literal: He was summoned to test for an academy post; Wang Tao impeached him and had him dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to test for an academy post. Wang Tao impeached him and had him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 熙甯初，王安石秉政，悅其才，用為編修三司條例官，加集賢校理、中書檢正。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, when Wang Anshi held power, he favored Dun's talent and employed him as compiler of the Fiscal Reform Commission, adding Jixian collator and Secretariat reviewer.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xining, when Wang Anshi held power, he favored Dun's talent and employed him as compiler of the Fiscal Reform Commission, adding Jixian collator and Secretariat reviewer.

sentences.zh: 時經制南、北江群蠻，命為湖南、北察訪使。

translations.literal: At the time the southern and northern Jiang tribal groups were being managed; he was appointed investigating commissioner of Hunan and Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the southern and northern Jiang tribal groups were being managed. He was appointed investigating commissioner of Hunan and Hubei.

sentences.zh: 提點刑獄趙鼎言，峽州群蠻苦其酋剝刻，謀內附，辰州布衣張翹亦言南、北江群蠻歸化朝廷，遂以事屬惇。

translations.literal: Judicial intendant Zhao Ding said the tribal groups of Xia Prefecture suffered from their chiefs' extortion and plotted to submit inward; Zhang Qiao, a commoner of Chen Prefecture, also said the southern and northern Jiang tribal groups wished to submit to the court—therefore the matter was entrusted to Dun.
translations.idiomatic: Judicial intendant Zhao Ding said the tribal groups of Xia Prefecture suffered from their chiefs' extortion and plotted to submit inward. Zhang Qiao, a commoner of Chen Prefecture, also said the southern and northern Jiang tribal groups wished to submit to the court. Therefore the matter was entrusted to Dun.

sentences.zh: 惇募流人李資、張竑等往招之，資、竑淫於夷婦，為酋所殺，遂致攻討，由是兩江扇動。

translations.literal: Dun recruited exiles Li Zi and Zhang Hong and others to go recruit them; Zi and Hong violated tribal women and were killed by the chiefs, leading to attack and suppression, and thereby both Jiang regions were stirred up.
translations.idiomatic: Dun recruited exiles Li Zi and Zhang Hong and others to go recruit them. Zi and Hong violated tribal women and were killed by the chiefs, leading to attack and suppression, and thereby both Jiang regions were stirred up.

sentences.zh: 神宗疑其擾命，安石戒惇勿輕動，惇竟以三路兵平懿、洽、鼎州。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong suspected he was disturbing orders; Anshi warned Dun not to act lightly, yet Dun ultimately used three-route troops to pacify Yi, Qia, and Ding prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong suspected he was disturbing orders. Anshi warned Dun not to act lightly, yet Dun ultimately used three-route troops to pacify Yi, Qia, and Ding prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以蠻方據潭之梅山，遂乘勢而南。

translations.literal: Because the tribal region held Meishan in Tan Prefecture, he then took advantage of momentum and went south.
translations.idiomatic: Because the tribal region held Meishan in Tan Prefecture, he then took advantage of momentum and went south.

sentences.zh: 轉運副使蔡燁言是役不可亟成，神宗以為然，專委于燁，安石主惇，爭之不已。

translations.literal: Transport vice commissioner Cai Ye said this campaign could not be quickly completed; Emperor Shenzong thought this correct and specially entrusted it to Ye. Anshi supported Dun and argued without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Transport vice commissioner Cai Ye said this campaign could not be quickly completed. Emperor Shenzong thought this correct and specially entrusted it to Ye. Anshi supported Dun and argued without cease.

sentences.zh: 既而燁得蠻地，安石恨燁沮惇，乃薄其賞，進惇修起居注，以是兵久不決。

translations.literal: Before long Ye obtained tribal territory; Anshi resented Ye for obstructing Dun, therefore reduced his reward and promoted Dun to compile the imperial diary—thereby the troops long remained undecided.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Ye obtained tribal territory. Anshi resented Ye for obstructing Dun, therefore reduced his reward and promoted Dun to compile the imperial diary—thereby the troops long remained undecided.

sentences.zh: 召惇還，擢知制誥、直學士院、判軍器監。

translations.literal: Dun was recalled and promoted to drafter of edicts, Hanlin academy scholar, and administrator of the Directorate of Armaments.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was recalled and promoted to drafter of edicts, Hanlin academy scholar, and administrator of the Directorate of Armaments.

sentences.zh: 三司火，神宗禦樓觀之，惇部役兵奔救，過樓下，神宗問知為惇，明日命為三司使。

translations.literal: The Three Departments caught fire; Emperor Shenzong went to the tower to watch. Dun's labor troops ran to rescue and passed below the tower. Shenzong asked and learned it was Dun; the next day he appointed him commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments caught fire. Emperor Shenzong went to the tower to watch. Dun's labor troops ran to rescue and passed below the tower. Shenzong asked and learned it was Dun; the next day he appointed him commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 呂惠卿去位，鄧綰論惇同惡，出知湖州，徙杭州。

translations.literal: When Lü Huiqing left office, Deng Wan spoke of Dun as sharing in wickedness; Dun was sent out as prefect of Hu Prefecture and transferred to Hang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Lü Huiqing left office, Deng Wan spoke of Dun as sharing in wickedness. Dun was sent out as prefect of Hu Prefecture and transferred to Hang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為翰林學士。

translations.literal: He entered court as Hanlin academician.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng he was appointed vice grand councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yuanfeng he was appointed vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 朱服為御史，惇密使客達意於服，為服所白。

translations.literal: Zhu Fu was investigating censor; Dun secretly had a guest convey his intent to Fu, and Fu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Fu was investigating censor. Dun secretly had a guest convey his intent to Fu, and Fu reported it.

sentences.zh: 惇父冒占民沈立田，立遮訴惇，惇系之開封。

translations.literal: Dun's father illegally occupied the land of the commoner Shen Li; Li blocked the road and sued Dun, and Dun had him detained in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Dun's father illegally occupied the land of the commoner Shen Li. Li blocked the road and sued Dun, and Dun had him detained in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 坐二罪，罷知蔡州，又曆陳、定二州。

translations.literal: Punished for two crimes, he was dismissed as prefect of Cai Prefecture and later served Chen and Ding prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Punished for two crimes, he was dismissed as prefect of Cai Prefecture and later served Chen and Ding prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五年，召拜門下侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was summoned and appointed Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 豐稷奏曰：「官府肇新而惇首用，非稽古建官意。」

translations.literal: Feng Ji memorialized: "The bureaucracy is newly established yet Dun is first employed—this is not the intent of examining antiquity in establishing offices."
translations.idiomatic: Feng Ji memorialized: "The bureaucracy is newly established yet Dun is first employed—this is not the intent of examining antiquity in establishing offices."

sentences.zh: 稷坐左遷。

translations.literal: Ji was punished with demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Ji was punished with demotion.

sentences.zh: 諫官趙彥若又疏惇無行，不報。

translations.literal: Remonstrance official Zhao Yanruo again memorialized that Dun was without conduct; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance official Zhao Yanruo again memorialized that Dun was without conduct; no response was given.

sentences.zh: 哲宗親政，有復熙甯、元豐之意，首起惇為尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎，於是專以「紹述」為國是，凡元祐所革一切復之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong personally took power, having the intent to restore Xining and Yuanfeng policies, he first recalled Dun as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery. Thereupon he exclusively took "continuing the legacy" as national policy and restored everything the Yuanyou era had changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong personally took power, having the intent to restore Xining and Yuanfeng policies, he first recalled Dun as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery. Thereupon he exclusively took "continuing the legacy" as national policy and restored everything the Yuanyou era had changed.

sentences.zh: 引蔡卞、林希、黃履、來之邵、張商英、周秩、翟思、上官均居要地，任言責，協謀朋奸，報復仇怨，小大之臣，無一得免，死者禍及其孥。

translations.literal: He brought in Cai Bian, Lin Xi, Huang Lü, Lai Zhi Shao, Zhang Shangying, Zhou Zhi, Zhai Si, and Shangguan Jun to important posts, entrusted them with remonstrance duties, conspired as a clique of traitors, avenged grudges, and ministers great and small—none escaped; the dead brought disaster even on their children.
translations.idiomatic: He brought in Cai Bian, Lin Xi, Huang Lü, Lai Zhi Shao, Zhang Shangying, Zhou Zhi, Zhai Si, and Shangguan Jun to important posts, entrusted them with remonstrance duties, conspired as a clique of traitors, avenged grudges, and ministers great and small—none escaped. The dead brought disaster even on their children.

sentences.zh: 甚至詆宣仁後，謂元祐之初，老奸擅國。

translations.literal: He even slandered Empress Dowager Xuanren, saying that at the beginning of Yuanyou old traitors monopolized the state.
translations.idiomatic: He even slandered Empress Dowager Xuanren, saying that at the beginning of Yuanyou old traitors monopolized the state.

sentences.zh: 又請發司馬光、呂公著塚，斫其棺。

translations.literal: He also requested opening the tombs of Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and chopping their coffins.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested opening the tombs of Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and chopping their coffins.

sentences.zh: 哲宗不聽，惇意不愜，請編類元祐諸臣章疏，識者知禍之未弭也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong would not listen; Dun was not satisfied and requested compiling and classifying the memorials of Yuanyou ministers—those who understood knew disaster was not yet ended.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong would not listen. Dun was not satisfied and requested compiling and classifying the memorials of Yuanyou ministers—those who understood knew disaster was not yet ended.

sentences.zh: 遂治劉安世、范祖禹諫禁中雇乳媼事，又以文及甫誣語書導蔡渭，使告劉摯、梁燾有逆謀，起同文館獄，命蔡京、安惇、蹇序辰窮治，欲覆諸人家。

translations.literal: He then prosecuted Liu Anshi and Fan Zuyu for remonstrating against hiring wet nurses in the inner palace; also using Wen Jifu's false words in a letter to guide Cai Wei, he had him accuse Liu Zhi and Liang Tao of treasonous plots, launched the Tongwen Pavilion prosecution, and ordered Cai Jing, An Dun, and Jian Xuchen to investigate exhaustively, intending to overturn all their families.
translations.idiomatic: He then prosecuted Liu Anshi and Fan Zuyu for remonstrating against hiring wet nurses in the inner palace. Also using Wen Jifu's false words in a letter to guide Cai Wei, he had him accuse Liu Zhi and Liang Tao of treasonous plots, launched the Tongwen Pavilion prosecution, and ordered Cai Jing, An Dun, and Jian Xuchen to investigate exhaustively, intending to overturn all their families.

sentences.zh: 又議遣呂升卿、董必察訪嶺南，將盡殺流人。

translations.literal: He also discussed sending Lü Shengqing and Dong Bi to inspect Lingnan, intending to kill all exiles.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed sending Lü Shengqing and Dong Bi to inspect Lingnan, intending to kill all exiles.

sentences.zh: 哲宗曰：「朕遵祖宗遺制，未嘗殺戮大臣，其釋勿治。」

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong said: "I follow the ancestral legacy and have never executed great ministers—release them and do not prosecute."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong said: "I follow the ancestral legacy and have never executed great ministers—release them and do not prosecute."

sentences.zh: 然重得罪者千餘人，或至三四謫徙，天下冤之。

translations.literal: Yet more than a thousand were heavily punished, some banished three or four times; the realm considered it unjust.
translations.idiomatic: Yet more than a thousand were heavily punished, some banished three or four times. The realm considered it unjust.

sentences.zh: 惇用邢恕為御史中丞，恕以北齊婁太后宮名宣訓，嘗廢孫少主立子常山王演，托司馬光語范祖禹曰：「方今主少國疑，宣訓事猶可慮。」

translations.literal: Dun employed Xing Shu as supervising censor; Shu, citing Northern Qi Empress Dowager Lou's palace name Xuanxun, who once deposed the young heir and established her son Changshan Wang Yan, attributed to Sima Guang words to Fan Zuyu: "Now the ruler is young and the state uncertain—the Xuanxun affair is still worth worrying about."
translations.idiomatic: Dun employed Xing Shu as supervising censor. Shu, citing Northern Qi Empress Dowager Lou's palace name Xuanxun, who once deposed the young heir and established her son Changshan Wang Yan, attributed to Sima Guang words to Fan Zuyu: "Now the ruler is young and the state uncertain—the Xuanxun affair is still worth worrying about."

sentences.zh: 又誘高士京上書，言父遵裕臨死屏左右謂士京曰：「神宗彌留之際，王珪遣高士充來問曰：'不知皇太后欲立誰？

translations.literal: He also induced Gao Shijing to submit a memorial, saying that on his deathbed his father Zunyü dismissed attendants and told Shijing: "When Emperor Shenzong was at his last breath, Wang Gui sent Gao Shichong to ask: 'I do not know whom the empress dowager wishes to establish?
translations.idiomatic: He also induced Gao Shijing to submit a memorial, saying that on his deathbed his father Zunyü dismissed attendants and told Shijing: "When Emperor Shenzong was at his last breath, Wang Gui sent Gao Shichong to ask: 'I do not know whom the empress dowager wishes to establish?

sentences.zh: '我叱士充去之。」

translations.literal: I rebuked Shichong and sent him away.'"
translations.idiomatic: I rebuked Shichong and sent him away.'"

sentences.zh: 皆欲誣宣仁後，以此實之。

translations.literal: All wished to falsely accuse Empress Dowager Xuanren and substantiate it with this.
translations.idiomatic: All wished to falsely accuse Empress Dowager Xuanren and substantiate it with this.

sentences.zh: 惇遂追貶司馬光、王珪，贈遵裕奉國軍留後。

translations.literal: Dun then posthumously demoted Sima Guang and Wang Gui and posthumously enfeoffed Zunyü as military commissioner deputy of Fengguo Army.
translations.idiomatic: Dun then posthumously demoted Sima Guang and Wang Gui and posthumously enfeoffed Zunyü as military commissioner deputy of Fengguo Army.

sentences.zh: 結中官郝隨為助，欲追廢宣仁後，自皇太后、太妃皆力爭之。

translations.literal: He joined with inner attendant Hao Sui as helper and wished to posthumously depose Empress Dowager Xuanren; from the empress dowager and consort dowager downward all strove against it.
translations.idiomatic: He joined with inner attendant Hao Sui as helper and wished to posthumously depose Empress Dowager Xuanren. From the empress dowager and consort dowager downward, all strove against it.

sentences.zh: 哲宗感悟，焚其奏，隨覘知之，密語惇與蔡卞。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhezong was moved and burned the memorial; Sui spied and learned of it and secretly told Dun and Cai Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhezong was moved and burned the memorial. Sui spied and learned of it and secretly told Dun and Cai Bian.

sentences.zh: 明日惇、卞再言，哲宗怒曰：「卿等不欲朕入英宗廟乎？」

translations.literal: The next day Dun and Bian spoke again; Emperor Zhezong angrily said: "Do you not wish me to enter Emperor Yingzong's temple?"
translations.idiomatic: The next day Dun and Bian spoke again. Emperor Zhezong angrily said: "Do you not wish me to enter Emperor Yingzong's temple?"

sentences.zh: 惇、卞乃已。

translations.literal: Dun and Bian then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Dun and Bian then stopped.

sentences.zh: 惇又以皇后孟氏，元祐中宣仁後所立，迎合郝隨，勸哲宗起掖庭秘獄，托以左道，廢居瑤華宮。

translations.literal: Dun also, because Empress Meng had been established by Empress Dowager Xuanren during Yuanyou, to please Hao Sui persuaded Emperor Zhezong to launch a secret prosecution in the inner quarters, using heterodox ways as pretext, and deposed her to live in Yaohua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Dun also, because Empress Meng had been established by Empress Dowager Xuanren during Yuanyou, to please Hao Sui persuaded Emperor Zhezong to launch a secret prosecution in the inner quarters, using heterodox ways as pretext, and deposed her to live in Yaohua Palace.

sentences.zh: 其後哲宗頗悔，乃歎曰：「章惇壞我名節。」

translations.literal: Afterward Emperor Zhezong greatly regretted it and sighed: "Zhang Dun has ruined my reputation."
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Emperor Zhezong greatly regretted it and sighed: "Zhang Dun has ruined my reputation."

sentences.zh: 惇又結劉友端相表裏，請建劉賢妃于中宮。

translations.literal: Dun also joined with Liu Youduan in league and requested establishing Consort Liu in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Dun also joined with Liu Youduan in league and requested establishing Consort Liu in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 初，神宗用王安石之言，開熙、河，謀靈、夏，師行十餘年不息。

translations.literal: At first Emperor Shenzong followed Wang Anshi's words, opened Xi and He, plotted Ling and Xia, and troops marched for more than ten years without cease.
translations.idiomatic: At first Emperor Shenzong followed Wang Anshi's words, opened Xi and He, plotted Ling and Xia, and troops marched for more than ten years without cease.

sentences.zh: 迨聞永樂之敗，神宗當寧慟哭，循致不豫，故元祐宰輔推本其意，專務懷柔外國。

translations.literal: When he heard of the defeat at Yongle, Emperor Shenzong wept at the throne and gradually fell ill; therefore Yuanyou chief ministers traced back to his intent and devoted themselves to conciliating foreign states.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard of the defeat at Yongle, Emperor Shenzong wept at the throne and gradually fell ill. Therefore Yuanyou chief ministers traced back to his intent and devoted themselves to conciliating foreign states.

sentences.zh: 西夏請故地，以非要害城砦還之。

translations.literal: Western Xia requested old territory; non-critical forts and stockades were returned.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia requested old territory, and non-critical forts and stockades were returned.

sentences.zh: 惇以為蹙國棄地，罪其帥臣，遂用淺攻撓耕之說，肆開邊隙，絕夏人歲賜，進築汝遮等城，陝西諸道興役五十餘所，敗軍覆將，復棄青唐，死傷不可計。

translations.literal: Dun considered this constricting the state and abandoning land and punished the frontier commanders; he then used shallow-attack and plow-raiding theories, wantonly opened frontier conflict, cut off annual gifts to the Xia, advanced building Ruzhe and other cities, launched more than fifty projects on Shaanxi circuits, armies were defeated and generals ruined, Qingtang was again abandoned, and dead and wounded were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Dun considered this constricting the state and abandoning land and punished the frontier commanders. He then used shallow-attack and plow-raiding theories, wantonly opened frontier conflict, cut off annual gifts to the Xia, advanced building Ruzhe and other cities, launched more than fifty projects on Shaanxi circuits, armies were defeated and generals ruined, Qingtang was again abandoned, and dead and wounded were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 知天下怨己，欲塞其議，請詔中外察民妄語者論如律。

translations.literal: Knowing the realm resented him, he wished to block their criticism and requested an edict that inside and outside the court investigate people who spoke rashly and punish according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing the realm resented him, he wished to block their criticism and requested an edict that inside and outside the court investigate people who spoke rashly and punish according to law.

sentences.zh: 優立賞邏，告訐之風浸盛。

translations.literal: Generous rewards were established for patrols, and the wind of informing gradually flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Generous rewards were established for patrols, and the wind of informing gradually flourished.

sentences.zh: 民有被酒狂訛者，詔貸其死，惇竟論殺之。

translations.literal: A commoner drunk and speaking wildly was by edict pardoned from death, yet Dun still prosecuted and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: A commoner drunk and speaking wildly was by edict pardoned from death, yet Dun still prosecuted and executed him.

sentences.zh: 用刑愈峻，然不能遏也。

translations.literal: Punishments grew ever harsher, yet they could not be restrained.
translations.idiomatic: Punishments grew ever harsher, yet they could not be restrained.

sentences.zh: 哲宗崩，皇太后議所立，惇厲聲曰：「以禮律言之，母弟簡王當立。」

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong died, the empress dowager discussed whom to establish. Dun said in a harsh voice: "According to ritual and law, the emperor's younger brother by the same mother, Prince Jian, should be established."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong died, the empress dowager discussed whom to establish. Dun said in a harsh voice: "According to ritual and law, the emperor's younger brother by the same mother, Prince Jian, should be established."

sentences.zh: 皇太后曰：「老身無子，諸王皆是神宗庶子。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager said: "This old body has no son; all the princes are Emperor Shenzong's sons by concubines."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said: "This old body has no son; all the princes are Emperor Shenzong's sons by concubines."

sentences.zh: 惇復曰：「以長則申王當立。」

translations.literal: Dun again said: "By seniority Prince Shen should be established."
translations.idiomatic: Dun again said: "By seniority Prince Shen should be established."

sentences.zh: 皇太后曰：「申王病，不可立。」

translations.literal: The empress dowager said: "Prince Shen is ill and cannot be established."
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said: "Prince Shen is ill and cannot be established."

sentences.zh: 惇尚欲言，知樞密院事曾布叱之曰：「章惇，聽太后處分。」

translations.literal: Dun still wished to speak; Bureau of Military Affairs chief Zeng Bu rebuked him: "Zhang Dun, obey the empress dowager's decision."
translations.idiomatic: Dun still wished to speak. Bureau of Military Affairs chief Zeng Bu rebuked him: "Zhang Dun, obey the empress dowager's decision."

sentences.zh: 皇太后決策立端王，是為徽宗，遷惇特進，封申國公。

translations.literal: The empress dowager decided to establish Prince Duan, who became Emperor Huizong; Dun was transferred to special advancement and enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager decided to establish Prince Duan, who became Emperor Huizong. Dun was transferred to special advancement and enfeoffed as Duke of Shen.

sentences.zh: 為山陵使，靈轝陷澤中，逾宿而行。

translations.literal: As imperial tomb commissioner, the imperial bier sank in a marsh and traveled only after a full night.
translations.idiomatic: As imperial tomb commissioner, the imperial bier sank in a marsh and traveled only after a full night.

sentences.zh: 言者劾其不恭，罷知越州，尋貶武昌軍節度副使、潭州安置。

translations.literal: Critics impeached him for disrespect; he was dismissed as prefect of Yue Prefecture and soon demoted to military commissioner deputy of Wuchang Army and assigned to Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Critics impeached him for disrespect. He was dismissed as prefect of Yue Prefecture and soon demoted to military commissioner deputy of Wuchang Army and assigned to Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 右正言任伯雨論其欲追廢宣仁後，又貶雷州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: Right Rectifier Ren Boyu spoke of his wish to posthumously depose Empress Dowager Xuanren; he was again demoted to army registrar of Lei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Right Rectifier Ren Boyu spoke of his wish to posthumously depose Empress Dowager Xuanren. He was again demoted to army registrar of Lei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，蘇轍謫雷州，不許占官舍，遂僦民屋，惇又以為強奪民居，下州追民究治，以僦券甚明，乃已。

translations.literal: At first Su Che was banished to Lei Prefecture and not permitted to occupy official quarters; he rented a commoner's house. Dun again considered this forcibly seizing a residence and ordered the prefecture to pursue the commoner for investigation; because the lease was very clear, it was dropped.
translations.idiomatic: At first Su Che was banished to Lei Prefecture and not permitted to occupy official quarters; he rented a commoner's house. Dun again considered this forcibly seizing a residence and ordered the prefecture to pursue the commoner for investigation. Because the lease was very clear, it was dropped.

sentences.zh: 至是，惇問舍於是民，民曰：「前蘇公來，為章丞相幾破我家，今不可也。」

translations.literal: When Dun asked to lodge with this commoner, the man said: "When former Su came, he nearly ruined my family for Chief Councilor Zhang; now it cannot be done."
translations.idiomatic: When Dun asked to lodge with this commoner, the man said: "When former Su came, he nearly ruined my family for Chief Councilor Zhang; now it cannot be done."

sentences.zh: 徙睦州，卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mu Prefecture and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Mu Prefecture and died.

sentences.zh: 惇敏識加人數等，窮凶稔惡，不肯以官爵私所親，四子連登科，獨季子援嘗為校書郎，餘皆隨牒東銓仕州縣，訖無顯者。

translations.literal: Dun was sharp-witted and added several ranks to people; utterly wicked, he would not give official ranks to those he favored privately. Four sons passed examinations in succession; only the youngest Yuan once served as collator—the rest took posts through the eastern selection board in prefectures and counties, and none achieved prominence.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was sharp-witted and added several ranks to people. Utterly wicked, he would not give official ranks to those he favored privately. Four sons passed examinations in succession; only the youngest Yuan once served as collator—the rest took posts through the eastern selection board in prefectures and counties, and none achieved prominence.

sentences.zh: 妻張氏甚賢，惇之入相也，張病且死，屬之曰：「君作相，幸勿報怨。」

translations.literal: His wife Lady Zhang was very worthy. When Dun entered the chief councilor's seat, Zhang was ill and dying and entrusted him: "You have become chief councilor; I hope you will not avenge grudges."
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Zhang was very worthy. When Dun entered the chief councilor's seat, Zhang was ill and dying and entrusted him: "You have become chief councilor; I hope you will not avenge grudges."

sentences.zh: 既祥，惇語陳瓘曰：「悼亡不堪，奈何？」

translations.literal: After the mourning period, Dun said to Chen Guan: "I cannot bear mourning for the dead—what am I to do?"
translations.idiomatic: After the mourning period, Dun said to Chen Guan: "I cannot bear mourning for the dead—what am I to do?"

sentences.zh: 瓘曰：「與其悲傷無益，曷若念其臨絕之言。」

translations.literal: Guan said: "Rather than grieving without benefit, why not remember her words at the end?"
translations.idiomatic: Guan said: "Rather than grieving without benefit, why not remember her words at the end?"

sentences.zh: 惇無以對。

translations.literal: Dun had nothing to reply.
translations.idiomatic: Dun had nothing to reply.

sentences.zh: 政和中，追贈觀文殿大學士。

translations.literal: During Zhenghe he was posthumously given Grand Hanlin Academic of the Guanwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: During Zhenghe he was posthumously given Grand Hanlin Academic of the Guanwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，高宗閱任伯雨章疏，手詔曰：「惇詆誣宣仁後，欲追廢為庶人，賴哲宗不從其請，使其言施用，豈不上累泰陵？

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, Emperor Gaozong read Ren Boyu's memorial and wrote by hand: "Dun slandered Empress Dowager Xuanren and wished to posthumously depose her as a commoner. Thanks to Emperor Zhezong not accepting his request—if his words had been applied, would it not have burdened Emperor Taizong above?
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, Emperor Gaozong read Ren Boyu's memorial and wrote by hand: "Dun slandered Empress Dowager Xuanren and wished to posthumously depose her as a commoner. Thanks to Emperor Zhezong not accepting his request—if his words had been applied, would it not have burdened Emperor Taizong above?

sentences.zh: 貶昭化軍節度副使，子孫不得仕於朝。」

translations.literal: He was demoted to military commissioner deputy of Zhaohua Army; his descendants were not permitted to serve at court."
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to military commissioner deputy of Zhaohua Army. His descendants were not permitted to serve at court."

sentences.zh: 詔下，海內稱快，獨其家猶為《辨誣論》，見者哂之。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, the realm rejoiced; only his family still wrote "Refuting the Slander," and those who saw it mocked them.
translations.idiomatic: When the edict was issued, the realm rejoiced. Only his family still wrote "Refuting the Slander," and those who saw it mocked them.

sentences.zh: 曾布字子宣，南丰人。

translations.literal: Zeng Bu, courtesy name Zixuan, was a native of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Bu, courtesy name Zixuan, was a native of Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 年十三而孤，学于兄巩，同登第，调宣州司户参军、怀仁令。

translations.literal: Orphaned at thirteen, he studied under his elder brother Gong and passed the examination together; he was assigned army registrar of Xuan Prefecture and magistrate of Huairen.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned at thirteen, he studied under his elder brother Gong and passed the examination together. He was assigned army registrar of Xuan Prefecture and magistrate of Huairen.

sentences.zh: 熙宁二年，徙开封，以韩维、王安石荐，上书言为政之本有二，曰厉风俗、择人才。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining he was transferred to Kaifeng; on Han Wei and Wang Anshi's recommendation he submitted a memorial saying the roots of governance are two: improving customs and selecting talent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xining he was transferred to Kaifeng. On Han Wei and Wang Anshi's recommendation he submitted a memorial saying the roots of governance are two: improving customs and selecting talent.

sentences.zh: 其要有八，曰劝农桑、理财赋、兴学校、审选举、责吏课、叙宗室、修武备、制远人。

translations.literal: The essentials number eight: encouraging farming and sericulture, managing finances and taxes, establishing schools, examining selection, evaluating officials' performance, ordering the imperial clan, repairing military preparations, and controlling distant peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The essentials number eight: encouraging farming and sericulture, managing finances and taxes, establishing schools, examining selection, evaluating officials' performance, ordering the imperial clan, repairing military preparations, and controlling distant peoples.

sentences.zh: 大率皆安石指也。

translations.literal: In general all largely followed Anshi's intent.
translations.idiomatic: In general all largely followed Anshi's intent.

sentences.zh: 神宗召见，论建合意，授太子中允、崇政殿说书，加集贤校理，判司农寺，检正中书五房。

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong summoned him; their discussion on state-building accorded with his intent. He was appointed palace attendant, lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall, Jixian collator, administrator of the Ministry of Revenue, and reviewer of the five sections of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong summoned him; their discussion on state-building accorded with his intent. He was appointed palace attendant, lecturer at the Chongzheng Hall, Jixian collator, administrator of the Ministry of Revenue, and reviewer of the five sections of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 凡三日，五受敕告。

translations.literal: Within three days he received five appointment edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Within three days he received five appointment edicts.

sentences.zh: 与吕惠卿共创青苗、助役、保甲、农田之法，一时故臣及朝士多争之。

translations.literal: With Lü Huiqing he jointly created the green-sprout, assisted-service, baojia, and farmland laws; at the time old ministers and court gentlemen mostly disputed them.
translations.idiomatic: With Lü Huiqing he jointly created the green-sprout, assisted-service, baojia, and farmland laws. At the time old ministers and court gentlemen mostly disputed them.

sentences.zh: 布疏言："陛下以不世出之资，登延硕学远识之臣，思大有为于天下，而大臣玩令，倡之于上，小臣横议，和之于下。

translations.literal: Bu memorialized: "Your Majesty, with an unprecedented endowment, has extended invitation to great scholars and far-seeing ministers, thinking to achieve much in the realm, yet great ministers play with orders and advocate from above while petty ministers speak wildly and harmonize from below."
translations.idiomatic: Bu memorialized: "Your Majesty, with an unprecedented endowment, has extended invitation to great scholars and far-seeing ministers, thinking to achieve much in the realm, yet great ministers play with orders and advocate from above while petty ministers speak wildly and harmonize from below."

sentences.zh: 人人窥伺间隙，巧言丑诋，以哗众罔上。

translations.literal: Everyone watches for gaps, speaks cleverly and slanders, to stir the crowd and deceive superiors.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone watches for gaps, speaks cleverly and slanders, to stir the crowd and deceive superiors.

sentences.zh: 是劝沮之术未明，而威福之用未果也。

translations.literal: This means the methods of encouragement and deterrence are not yet clear, and the use of authority and favor has not yet succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: This means the methods of encouragement and deterrence are not yet clear, and the use of authority and favor has not yet succeeded.

sentences.zh: 陛下诚推赤心以待遇君子而厉其气，奋威断以屏斥小人而消其萌，使四方晓然皆知主不可抗，法不可侮，则何为而不可，何欲而不成哉？

translations.literal: If Your Majesty truly pushes forth a sincere heart to treat gentlemen well and stiffen their spirit, and exerts decisive authority to expel petty men and eliminate their sprouts, so that all four directions clearly know the ruler cannot be resisted and laws cannot be insulted—then what cannot be done, what desire not achieved?
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty truly pushes forth a sincere heart to treat gentlemen well and stiffen their spirit, and exerts decisive authority to expel petty men and eliminate their sprouts, so that all four directions clearly know the ruler cannot be resisted and laws cannot be insulted—then what cannot be done, what desire not achieved?

sentences.zh: "布欲坚神宗意，使专任安石以威胁众，使毋敢言。

translations.literal: Bu wished to firm Shenzong's intent, making him exclusively employ Anshi to threaten the multitude so none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Bu wished to firm Shenzong's intent, making him exclusively employ Anshi to threaten the multitude so none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 故骤见拔用，遂修起居注、知制诰，为翰林学士兼三司使。

translations.literal: Therefore he was suddenly promoted and appointed, then compiled the imperial diary, became drafter of edicts, and Hanlin academician concurrently commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he was suddenly promoted and appointed, then compiled the imperial diary, became drafter of edicts, and Hanlin academician concurrently commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 韩琦上疏极论新法之害，神宗颇悟，布遂为安石条析而驳之，持之愈固。

translations.literal: Han Qi submitted a memorial vehemently discussing the new laws' harm; Shenzong was somewhat moved. Bu then itemized and refuted for Anshi, holding all the more firmly.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi submitted a memorial vehemently discussing the new laws' harm. Shenzong was somewhat moved. Bu then itemized and refuted for Anshi, holding all the more firmly.

sentences.zh: 七年，大旱，诏求直言，布论判官吕嘉问市易掊克之虐，大概以为："天下之财匮乏，良由货不流通；

translations.literal: In the seventh year, during great drought, an edict sought frank speech. Bu discussed judicial assistant Lü Jiawen's market-trade extortion and cruelty, generally holding that: "The realm's wealth is depleted, truly because goods do not circulate;"
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, during great drought, an edict sought frank speech. Bu discussed judicial assistant Lü Jiawen's market-trade extortion and cruelty, generally holding that: "The realm's wealth is depleted, truly because goods do not circulate;"

sentences.zh: 货不流通，由商贾不行；

translations.literal: goods do not circulate because merchants do not travel;
translations.idiomatic: goods do not circulate because merchants do not travel;

sentences.zh: 商贾不行，由兼并之家巧为摧抑。

translations.literal: merchants do not travel because consolidating families cleverly suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: merchants do not travel because consolidating families cleverly suppress them.

sentences.zh: 故设市易于京师以售四方之货，常低仰其价，使高于兼并之家而低于倍蓰之直，官不失二分之息，则商贾自然无滞矣。

translations.literal: Therefore market-trade was established in the capital to sell goods from the four directions, regularly adjusting prices so they are higher than consolidating families and lower than doubled prices; the state loses not two-tenths interest, then merchants naturally have no stagnation.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore market-trade was established in the capital to sell goods from the four directions, regularly adjusting prices so they are higher than consolidating families and lower than doubled prices. The state loses not two-tenths interest, then merchants naturally have no stagnation.

sentences.zh: 今嘉问乃差官于四方买物货，禁客旅无得先交易，以息多寡为诛赏殿最，故官吏、牙驵惟恐裒之不尽而息之不夥，则是官自为兼并，殊非市易本意也。

translations.literal: Now Jiawen sends officials to the four directions to buy goods, forbids travelers from trading first, and uses profit more or less for punishment, reward, demotion, and ranking—therefore officials and brokers only fear not gathering everything and not maximizing profit. This is the state itself consolidating—far from market-trade's original intent.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jiawen sends officials to the four directions to buy goods, forbids travelers from trading first, and uses profit more or less for punishment, reward, demotion, and ranking. Therefore officials and brokers only fear not gathering everything and not maximizing profit. This is the state itself consolidating—far from market-trade's original intent.

sentences.zh: "事下两制议，惠卿以为沮新法，安石怒，布遂去位。

translations.literal: The matter went down to the two academies for discussion; Huiqing considered it obstructing the new laws. Anshi grew angry and Bu then left office.
translations.idiomatic: The matter went down to the two academies for discussion. Huiqing considered it obstructing the new laws. Anshi grew angry and Bu then left office.

sentences.zh: 惠卿参大政，置狱举劾，黜布知饶州，徙潭州。

translations.literal: When Huiqing joined major government, he set up prosecutions and impeachments, demoted Bu as prefect of Rao Prefecture, and transferred him to Tan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Huiqing joined major government, he set up prosecutions and impeachments, demoted Bu as prefect of Rao Prefecture, and transferred him to Tan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 复集贤院学士、知广州。

translations.literal: He was again Jixian Academy scholar and prefect of Guang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was again Jixian Academy scholar and prefect of Guang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元丰初，以龙图阁待制知桂州，进直学士、知秦州，改历陈、蔡、庆州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanfeng he was Hanlin attendant and prefect of Gui Prefecture, promoted to Hanlin scholar and prefect of Qin Prefecture, then changed to Chen, Cai, and Qing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanfeng he was Hanlin attendant and prefect of Gui Prefecture, promoted to Hanlin scholar and prefect of Qin Prefecture, then changed to Chen, Cai, and Qing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 元丰末，复翰林学士，迁户部尚书。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanfeng he was again Hanlin academician and promoted to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yuanfeng he was again Hanlin academician and promoted to Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 司马光为政，谕令增捐役法，布辞曰："免役一事，法令纤悉皆出己手，若令遽自改易，义不可为。

translations.literal: When Sima Guang held government, he instructed that the exemption-from-corvée law be increased and amended. Bu declined: "The exemption-from-service matter—every detailed regulation came from my own hand. If ordered to suddenly change it myself, righteousness cannot allow it."
translations.idiomatic: When Sima Guang held government, he instructed that the exemption-from-corvée law be increased and amended. Bu declined: "The exemption-from-service matter—every detailed regulation came from my own hand. If ordered to suddenly change it myself, righteousness cannot allow it."

sentences.zh: "元祐初，以龙图阁学士知太原府，历真定、河阳及青、瀛二州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou he was Hanlin scholar and prefect of Taiyuan, serving Zhending, Heyang, and Qing and Ying prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanyou he was Hanlin scholar and prefect of Taiyuan, serving Zhending, Heyang, and Qing and Ying prefectures.

sentences.zh: 绍圣初，徙江宁，过京，留为翰林学士，迁承旨兼侍读，拜同知枢密院，进知院事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng he was transferred to Jiangning; passing the capital he was kept as Hanlin academician, promoted to chief academician with concurrent duty as imperial reader, appointed vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and advanced to director.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaosheng he was transferred to Jiangning. Passing the capital he was kept as Hanlin academician, promoted to chief academician with concurrent duty as imperial reader, appointed vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and advanced to director.

sentences.zh: 初，章惇为相，布草制极其称美，冀惇引为同省执政，惇忌之，止荐居枢府，故稍不相能。

translations.literal: At first when Zhang Dun was chief councilor, Bu drafted the edict with extreme praise, hoping Dun would bring him into the Secretariat as fellow chief councilor. Dun resented him and only recommended him for the Military Affairs Bureau—therefore they gradually could not cooperate.
translations.idiomatic: At first when Zhang Dun was chief councilor, Bu drafted the edict with extreme praise, hoping Dun would bring him into the Secretariat as fellow chief councilor. Dun resented him and only recommended him for the Military Affairs Bureau—therefore they gradually could not cooperate.

sentences.zh: 布赞惇"绍述"甚力，请甄赏元祐臣庶论更役法不便者，以劝敢言。

translations.literal: Bu supported Dun's "continuing the legacy" with great force and requested selecting and rewarding Yuanyou officials and commoners who spoke of the corvée law's inconvenience, to encourage bold speech.
translations.idiomatic: Bu supported Dun's "continuing the legacy" with great force and requested selecting and rewarding Yuanyou officials and commoners who spoke of the corvée law's inconvenience, to encourage bold speech.

sentences.zh: 惇遂兴大狱，陷正人，流贬镌废，略无虚日，布多阴挤之。

translations.literal: Dun then launched great prosecutions, trapped upright men, exiled, demoted, and stripped posts—hardly a day without it; Bu often secretly squeezed them out.
translations.idiomatic: Dun then launched great prosecutions, trapped upright men, exiled, demoted, and stripped posts—hardly a day without it. Bu often secretly squeezed them out.

sentences.zh: 掖庭诏狱成，付执政蔽罪，法官谓厌魅事未成，不当处极典。

translations.literal: When the inner-quarters edict prosecution was complete, it was given to chief councilors to cover crimes; judges said the sorcery matter was not complete and should not receive extreme punishment.
translations.idiomatic: When the inner-quarters edict prosecution was complete, it was given to chief councilors to cover crimes. Judges said the sorcery matter was not complete and should not receive extreme punishment.

sentences.zh: 布曰："驴媚蛇雾，是未成否？

translations.literal: Bu said: "Donkey-flattery and snake-mist—is this not complete?"
translations.idiomatic: Bu said: "Donkey-flattery and snake-mist—is this not complete?"

sentences.zh: "众皆瞿然，于是死者三人。

translations.literal: All were startled; thereby three died.
translations.idiomatic: All were startled; thereby three died.

sentences.zh: 惇以士心不附，诡情饰过，荐引名士彭汝砺、陈瓘、张庭坚等，乞正所夺司马光、吕公著赠谥，勿毁墓仆碑，布以为无益之事。

translations.literal: Dun, because scholar-officials' hearts did not attach, feigned sentiment and adorned faults, recommended famous scholars Peng Ruli, Chen Guan, and Zhang Tingjian, and requested correcting the posthumous titles stripped from Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and not destroying tombs or toppling steles. Bu considered these useless matters.
translations.idiomatic: Dun, because scholar-officials' hearts did not attach, feigned sentiment and adorned faults, recommended famous scholars Peng Ruli, Chen Guan, and Zhang Tingjian, and requested correcting the posthumous titles stripped from Sima Guang and Lü Gongzhu and not destroying tombs or toppling steles. Bu considered these useless matters.

sentences.zh: 又奏："人主操柄，不可倒持，今自丞弼以至言者，知畏宰相，不知畏陛下。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The ruler's handle cannot be held upside down. Now from vice councilors to remonstrance officials, all fear the chief councilor and do not fear Your Majesty."
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized: "The ruler's handle cannot be held upside down. Now from vice councilors to remonstrance officials, all fear the chief councilor and do not fear Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 臣如不言，孰敢言者？

translations.literal: If your subject does not speak, who dares speak?
translations.idiomatic: If your subject does not speak, who dares speak?

sentences.zh: "其意盖欲倾惇而未能。

translations.literal: His intent was to overturn Dun but he could not.
translations.idiomatic: His intent was to overturn Dun but he could not.

sentences.zh: 会哲宗崩，皇太后召宰执问谁可立，惇有异议，布叱惇使从皇太后命。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhezong died, the empress dowager summoned chief councilors to ask who could be established; Dun had dissenting views and Bu rebuked Dun to obey the empress dowager's command.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhezong died, the empress dowager summoned chief councilors to ask who could be established. Dun had dissenting views and Bu rebuked Dun to obey the empress dowager's command.

sentences.zh: 徽宗立，惇得罪罢，遣中使召蔡京钅巢院，拜韩忠彦左仆射。

translations.literal: When Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, Dun was dismissed for offense; inner envoys were sent to summon Cai Jing to the Hanlin Academy and appoint Han Zhongyan Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Huizong ascended the throne, Dun was dismissed for offense. Inner envoys were sent to summon Cai Jing to the Hanlin Academy and appoint Han Zhongyan Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 京欲探徽宗意，徐请曰："麻词未审合作专任一相，或作分命两相之意。

translations.literal: Jing wished to probe Huizong's intent and slowly asked: "The edict draft—is it not yet known whether to make one chief councilor solely responsible or to divide appointment between two chief councilors?"
translations.idiomatic: Jing wished to probe Huizong's intent and slowly asked: "The edict draft—is it not yet known whether to make one chief councilor solely responsible or to divide appointment between two chief councilors?"

sentences.zh: "徽宗曰："专任一相。

translations.literal: Huizong said: "One chief councilor solely responsible."
translations.idiomatic: Huizong said: "One chief councilor solely responsible."

sentences.zh: "京出，宣言曰："子宣不复相矣。

translations.literal: Jing went out and declared: "Zixuan will not be chief councilor again."
translations.idiomatic: Jing went out and declared: "Zixuan will not be chief councilor again."

sentences.zh: "已而复召曾肇草制，拜布右仆射，其制曰："东西分台，左右建辅。

translations.literal: Soon Zeng Zhao was again summoned to draft the edict; Bu was appointed Right Vice Director. The edict said: "Eastern and western platforms, left and right assistants established."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zeng Zhao was again summoned to draft the edict. Bu was appointed Right Vice Director. The edict said: "Eastern and western platforms, left and right assistants established."

sentences.zh: "忠彦虽居上，然柔懦，事多决于布，布犹不能容。

translations.literal: Although Zhongyan was senior, he was soft and timid and many matters were decided by Bu; Bu still could not tolerate him.
translations.idiomatic: Although Zhongyan was senior, he was soft and timid and many matters were decided by Bu. Bu still could not tolerate him.

sentences.zh: 时议以元祐、绍圣均为有失，欲以大公至正消释朋党，明年，乃改元建中靖国，邪正杂用，忠彦遂罢去。

translations.literal: At the time critics held that both Yuanyou and Shaosheng were in error and wished to use great fairness and utmost rectitude to dissolve factional strife. The next year they changed the era name to Jianzhong Jingguo, mixing the wicked and upright; Zhongyan was then dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: At the time critics held that both Yuanyou and Shaosheng were in error and wished to use great fairness and utmost rectitude to dissolve factional strife. The next year they changed the era name to Jianzhong Jingguo, mixing the wicked and upright. Zhongyan was then dismissed.

sentences.zh: 布独当国，渐进"绍述"之说。

translations.literal: Bu alone held the state and gradually advanced "continuing the legacy" doctrine.
translations.idiomatic: Bu alone held the state and gradually advanced "continuing the legacy" doctrine.

sentences.zh: 明年，又改元崇宁，召蔡京为左丞，京与布异。

translations.literal: The next year they again changed the era name to Chongning and summoned Cai Jing as Left Vice Director; Jing differed from Bu.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they again changed the era name to Chongning and summoned Cai Jing as Left Vice Director. Jing differed from Bu.

sentences.zh: 会布拟陈佑甫为户部侍郎，京奏曰："爵禄者，陛下之爵禄，奈何使宰相私其亲？

translations.literal: When Bu proposed Chen Youfu as vice minister of revenue, Jing memorialized: "Rank and salary are Your Majesty's rank and salary—how can the chief councilor favor his kin?"
translations.idiomatic: When Bu proposed Chen Youfu as vice minister of revenue, Jing memorialized: "Rank and salary are Your Majesty's rank and salary—how can the chief councilor favor his kin?"

sentences.zh: "布婿陈迪，佑甫子也。

translations.literal: Bu's son-in-law Chen Di was Youfu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Bu's son-in-law Chen Di was Youfu's son.

sentences.zh: 布忿然争辨，久之，声色稍厉。

translations.literal: Bu angrily argued; after a long time his voice and manner grew somewhat harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Bu angrily argued. After a long time his voice and manner grew somewhat harsh.

sentences.zh: 温益叱布曰："曾布，上前安得失礼？

translations.literal: Wen Yi rebuked Bu: "Zeng Bu, how can you be impolite before the emperor?"
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yi rebuked Bu: "Zeng Bu, how can you be impolite before the emperor?"

sentences.zh: "徽宗不悦而罢。

translations.literal: Huizong was displeased and dismissed the session.
translations.idiomatic: Huizong was displeased and dismissed the session.

sentences.zh: 御史遂攻之，罢为观文殿大学士、知润州。

translations.literal: Investigating censors then attacked him; he was dismissed as Grand Hanlin Academic and prefect of Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors then attacked him. He was dismissed as Grand Hanlin Academic and prefect of Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 京积憾未已，加布以赃贿，令开封吕嘉问逮捕其诸子，锻炼讯鞫，诱左证使自诬而贷其罪。

translations.literal: Jing's accumulated resentment was not yet ended; he added charges of bribery against Bu, had Kaifeng Lü Jiawen arrest all his sons, forged interrogations, induced witnesses to self-incriminate and pardoned their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's accumulated resentment was not yet ended. He added charges of bribery against Bu, had Kaifeng Lü Jiawen arrest all his sons, forged interrogations, induced witnesses to self-incriminate and pardoned their crimes.

sentences.zh: 布落职，提举太清宫、太平州居住。

translations.literal: Bu was stripped of rank and made commissioner of the Supreme Clarity Abbey, living in Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bu was stripped of rank and made commissioner of the Supreme Clarity Abbey, living in Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 又降司农卿、分司南京。

translations.literal: Again demoted to vice director of the Ministry of Revenue with nominal duty in the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Again demoted to vice director of the Ministry of Revenue with nominal duty in the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 又以尝荐学官赵谂而谂叛，责散官、衡州安置。

translations.literal: Also because he once recommended academy official Zhao Shen and Shen rebelled, he was punished as common official and assigned to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Also because he once recommended academy official Zhao Shen and Shen rebelled, he was punished as common official and assigned to Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又以弃湟州，责贺州别驾，又责廉州司户。

translations.literal: Also because he abandoned Huang Prefecture, punished as assistant prefect of He Prefecture, again punished as registrar of Lian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Also because he abandoned Huang Prefecture, punished as assistant prefect of He Prefecture, again punished as registrar of Lian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 凡四年，乃徙舒州，复太中大夫、提举崇福宫。

translations.literal: After four years he was transferred to Shu Prefecture, restored to Grandee of Supreme Harmony and commissioner of the Chongfu Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: After four years he was transferred to Shu Prefecture, restored to Grandee of Supreme Harmony and commissioner of the Chongfu Abbey.

sentences.zh: 大观元年，卒于润州，年七十二。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan he died in Run Prefecture at seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daguan he died in Run Prefecture at seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 后赠观文殿大学士，谥曰文肃。

translations.literal: Later posthumously given Grand Hanlin Academic; posthumous title Wensu.
translations.idiomatic: Later posthumously given Grand Hanlin Academic; posthumous title Wensu.

sentences.zh: 安惇，字處厚，廣安軍人。

translations.literal: An Dun, courtesy name Chuhou, was a native of Guang'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: An Dun, courtesy name Chuhou, was a native of Guang'an Army.

sentences.zh: 上舍及第，調成都府教授。

translations.literal: He passed the upper academy examination and was assigned professor of Chengdu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the upper academy examination and was assigned professor of Chengdu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上書論學制，召對，擢監察御史。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial discussing the school system, was summoned for audience, and promoted to investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial discussing the school system, was summoned for audience, and promoted to investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 哲宗初政，許察官言事，諫議大夫孫覺請汰其不可者，詔劉摯推擇，罷惇為利州路轉運判官，曆夔州、湖北、江東三路。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Zhezong's personal rule, censorial officials were permitted to speak on affairs. Remonstrance Grandee Sun Jue requested eliminating those unfit; an edict had Liu Zhi select and dismiss; Dun was dismissed as transport judicial commissioner of Lizhou circuit, serving Li, Hubei, and Jiangdong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Zhezong's personal rule, censorial officials were permitted to speak on affairs. Remonstrance Grandee Sun Jue requested eliminating those unfit. An edict had Liu Zhi select and dismiss; Dun was dismissed as transport judicial commissioner of Lizhou circuit, serving Li, Hubei, and Jiangdong circuits.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，召為國子司業，三遷諫議大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaosheng he was summoned as vice director of the Directorate of Education and three times promoted to Remonstrance Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Shaosheng he was summoned as vice director of the Directorate of Education and three times promoted to Remonstrance Grandee.

sentences.zh: 章惇、蔡卞造同文謗獄，使蔡京與惇雜治，二人肆其忮心，上言：「司馬光、劉摯、梁燾、呂大防等交通陳衍之徒，變先帝成法，懼陛下一日親政，必有欺君之誅，乃密為傾搖之計。

translations.literal: Zhang Dun and Cai Bian created the Tongwen slander prosecution; they had Cai Jing and An Dun jointly investigate. The two gave free rein to their jealous hearts and memorialized: "Sima Guang, Liu Zhi, Liang Tao, Lü Dafang and others associated with Chen Yan's group changed the late emperor's established laws, fearing that when Your Majesty one day personally took power there would be punishment for deceiving the ruler—they secretly made plans to shake the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dun and Cai Bian created the Tongwen slander prosecution. They had Cai Jing and An Dun jointly investigate. The two gave free rein to their jealous hearts and memorialized: "Sima Guang, Liu Zhi, Liang Tao, Lü Dafang and others associated with Chen Yan's group changed the late emperor's established laws, fearing that when Your Majesty one day personally took power there would be punishment for deceiving the ruler—they secretly made plans to shake the throne.

sentences.zh: 於是疏隔兩宮，斥隨龍內侍，以去陛下之腹心；

translations.literal: Thereby they separated the two palaces and expelled inner attendants who followed the dragon, to remove Your Majesty's trusted confidants;
translations.idiomatic: Thereby they separated the two palaces and expelled inner attendants who followed the dragon, to remove Your Majesty's trusted confidants;

sentences.zh: 廢顧命大臣，以翦陛下之羽翼。

translations.literal: they dismissed entrusted great ministers to cut Your Majesty's wings.
translations.idiomatic: they dismissed entrusted great ministers to cut Your Majesty's wings.

sentences.zh: 縱釋先帝之所罪，收用先帝之所棄。

translations.literal: They released those the late emperor had punished and employed those the late emperor had cast out.
translations.idiomatic: They released those the late emperor had punished and employed those the late emperor had cast out.

sentences.zh: 無君之惡，同司馬昭之心；

translations.literal: Wickedness without a ruler—same as Sima Zhao's heart;
translations.idiomatic: Wickedness without a ruler—same as Sima Zhao's heart;

sentences.zh: 擅事之跡，過趙高指鹿為馬。

translations.literal: usurpation of affairs surpassing Zhao Gao pointing at a deer and calling it a horse.
translations.idiomatic: usurpation of affairs surpassing Zhao Gao pointing at a deer and calling it a horse.

sentences.zh: 比詢究本末，得其情狀，大逆不道，死有餘責。」

translations.literal: Now inquiring into origins and ends, obtaining the circumstances—the great crime of treason, death with surplus guilt."
translations.idiomatic: Now inquiring into origins and ends, obtaining the circumstances—the great crime of treason, death with surplus guilt."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「元祐人果如是乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Were Yuanyou men truly thus?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Were Yuanyou men truly thus?"

sentences.zh: 惇、京曰：「誠有是心，特反形未具耳。」

translations.literal: Dun and Jing said: "They truly had this heart; only the reverse form was not yet complete."
translations.idiomatic: Dun and Jing said: "They truly had this heart; only the reverse form was not yet complete."

sentences.zh: 帝為誅衍，錮摯、燾子孫。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore executed Yan and imprisoned Zhi and Tao's descendants.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore executed Yan and imprisoned Zhi and Tao's descendants.

sentences.zh: 遷御史中丞。

translations.literal: Dun was transferred to supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: Dun was transferred to supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 劉後之受冊也，百官仗衛陳於大庭，是日天氣清晏，惇巍立班中，倡言曰：「今日之事，上當天心，下合人望。」

translations.literal: When Empress Liu received the seal, all officials' guard formations were arrayed in the great court. That day the weather was clear and calm. Dun stood towering in the ranks and proclaimed: "Today's affair accords with heaven above and people's hopes below."
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Liu received the seal, all officials' guard formations were arrayed in the great court. That day the weather was clear and calm. Dun stood towering in the ranks and proclaimed: "Today's affair accords with heaven above and people's hopes below."

sentences.zh: 朝士皆笑其奸佞。

translations.literal: Court gentlemen all laughed at his treachery and flattery.
translations.idiomatic: Court gentlemen all laughed at his treachery and flattery.

sentences.zh: 又鞫鄒浩事，檄廣東使者鐘正甫攝治之於新州，士大夫或千里會逮，踵蹇序辰初議，閱訴理書牘，被禍者七八百人，天下怨疾，為二蔡、二惇之謠。

translations.literal: He also tried Zou Hao's case, ordering Guangdong envoy Zhong Zhengfu to take charge of prosecution in Xin Prefecture. Some scholar-officials traveled a thousand li to be seized; following Jian Xuchen's initial proposal, reviewing appeal documents, seven or eight hundred were harmed—the realm resented and hated this, making the rhyme of the two Cais and two Duns.
translations.idiomatic: He also tried Zou Hao's case, ordering Guangdong envoy Zhong Zhengfu to take charge of prosecution in Xin Prefecture. Some scholar-officials traveled a thousand li to be seized. Following Jian Xuchen's initial proposal, reviewing appeal documents, seven or eight hundred were harmed—the realm resented and hated this, making the rhyme of the two Cais and two Duns.

sentences.zh: 徽宗雅惡之。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong greatly hated him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong greatly hated him.

sentences.zh: 鄒浩還朝，惇言：「浩若復用，慮彰先帝之失。」

translations.literal: When Zou Hao returned to court, Dun said: "If Hao is again employed, I fear it will expose the late emperor's fault."
translations.idiomatic: When Zou Hao returned to court, Dun said: "If Hao is again employed, I fear it will expose the late emperor's fault."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「立後，大事也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Establishing the heir is a great matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Establishing the heir is a great matter.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞不言而浩獨敢言之，何為不可復用？」

translations.literal: The supervising censor did not speak yet Hao alone dared to speak—why can he not be reused?"
translations.idiomatic: The supervising censor did not speak, yet Hao alone dared to speak—why can he not be reused?"

sentences.zh: 惇懼而退。

translations.literal: Dun withdrew in fear.
translations.idiomatic: Dun withdrew in fear.

sentences.zh: 陳瓘請曰：「陛下欲開正路，取浩既往之善，惇乃詿惑主聽，規騁其私，若明示好惡，當自惇始。」

translations.literal: Chen Guan requested: "Your Majesty wishes to open the upright path and take Hao's past good—Dun instead deludes the ruler's ears and schemes for his private ends. If likes and dislikes are clearly shown, it should begin with Dun."
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guan requested: "Your Majesty wishes to open the upright path and take Hao's past good. Dun instead deludes the ruler's ears and schemes for his private ends. If likes and dislikes are clearly shown, it should begin with Dun."

sentences.zh: 乃以寶文閣待制知潭州，尋放歸田裏。

translations.literal: He was then made Hanlin attendant and prefect of Tan Prefecture, and soon released to return to his fields.
translations.idiomatic: He was then made Hanlin attendant and prefect of Tan Prefecture, and soon released to return to his fields.

sentences.zh: 蔡京為相，復拜工部侍郎、兵部尚書。

translations.literal: When Cai Jing became chief councilor, Dun was again appointed vice minister of works and Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: When Cai Jing became chief councilor, Dun was again appointed vice minister of works and Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 崇甯初，同知樞密院。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning he was vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Chongning he was vice director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈特進。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously given special advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously given special advancement.

sentences.zh: 長子郊，後坐指斥誅。

translations.literal: His eldest son Jiao was later executed for pointing out and denouncing.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Jiao was later executed for pointing out and denouncing.

sentences.zh: 流其次子邦于涪而追貶惇單州團練副使，其祀遂絕。

translations.literal: His second son Bang was exiled to Fu and Dun was posthumously demoted to military training deputy of Shan Prefecture; his sacrificial line thus ended.
translations.idiomatic: His second son Bang was exiled to Fu, and Dun was posthumously demoted to military training deputy of Shan Prefecture. His sacrificial line thus ended.

sentences.zh: 人以為惇平生數陷忠良之報雲。

translations.literal: People considered this retribution for Dun's lifetime of repeatedly trapping the loyal and good.
translations.idiomatic: People considered this retribution for Dun's lifetime of repeatedly trapping the loyal and good.
